problem_text:
A logistics company is selecting cargo containers to ship on a freighter. Available containers are:

* Container 1: volume 36 m³, revenue $277
* Container 2: volume 36 m³, revenue $242
* Container 3: volume 12 m³, revenue $258
* Container 4: volume 45 m³, revenue $76
* Container 5: volume 31 m³, revenue $256
* Container 6: volume 36 m³, revenue $194
* Container 7: volume 44 m³, revenue $267
* Container 8: volume 49 m³, revenue $26
* Container 9: volume 14 m³, revenue $94
* Container 10: volume 5 m³, revenue $170
* Container 11: volume 25 m³, revenue $264
* Container 12: volume 26 m³, revenue $278
* Container 13: volume 26 m³, revenue $28
* Container 14: volume 38 m³, revenue $172
* Container 15: volume 10 m³, revenue $91
* Container 16: volume 17 m³, revenue $93
* Container 17: volume 38 m³, revenue $96
* Container 18: volume 30 m³, revenue $61
* Container 19: volume 39 m³, revenue $189
* Container 20: volume 40 m³, revenue $124
* Container 21: volume 35 m³, revenue $216
* Container 22: volume 21 m³, revenue $80
* Container 23: volume 38 m³, revenue $276
* Container 24: volume 39 m³, revenue $237
* Container 25: volume 34 m³, revenue $65
* Container 26: volume 26 m³, revenue $202
* Container 27: volume 19 m³, revenue $180
* Container 28: volume 29 m³, revenue $298
* Container 29: volume 43 m³, revenue $173
* Container 30: volume 25 m³, revenue $243

The freighter has a maximum cargo capacity of 634 m³. Select the container combination that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this volume limit. Each container is either fully loaded or left behind.
